title: Console async handoff + UI prototype digest
body:
Date: 2026-03-23
Type: async standup / on-call handoff / prototyping notes
Owners: Maya Chen (primary), Jordan Patel (analytics), Sofia Alvarez (UX), Liam O'Rourke (infra)

Purpose:
- Capture today's console-and-tooling async standup and a short handoff for the weekend on-call cadence.
- Summarize UI prototype learnings from the rollout canary and list next action items for instrumentation and fallback behavior.

Attendees (channels):
- #console-tooling (thread), DM with Anika for canary feedback, quick sync with infra on region routing

Quick status (by area):
- UI (Sofia): working prototype for the route rollout modal is functionally complete. Found a microcopy issue where users misinterpret "Fallback model" vs "Fallback behavior" — updated copy to "Fallback to alternate model" in prototype v3.
- Rollouts (Maya/Jordan): canary rollout completed for 5% of traffic in us-west1. No P0 errors but noticed error spike in tokenization failures (ENG-1883) around long prompt truncation. Investigating.
- Analytics (Jordan): added event instrumentation for rollout decisions (route_selected, fallback_triggered, model_variant) and first-pass dashboard queries. Initial dashboards show 0.6% fallback rate, 70th percentile latency drop (when using cached prefixes) ~12ms.
- Infra (Liam): temporary capacity bump scheduled for tomorrow to handle planned load test. Confirmed hotspot mitigation for kv-cache warms.

Recent discoveries / incidents:
- Tokenization truncation issue: a subset of customer prompts with mixed UTF-8 punctuation hit a tokenizer boundary and produced empty-generation responses. Repro steps and draft fix in ENG-1883. Rolling a hotfix branch: PR#4821.
- UX confusion: testers assumed fallback selection was permanent — need to make the modal explicitly show "applies to this request" vs "apply to route". Raised as microtask for Sofia.

Data & metrics to watch (next 48h):
- fallback_triggered rate by route: target <1% for baseline. Current: 0.6% overall, top offender route: /v1/generate-chat (1.9% for canary).
- tokenization_failure count: target 0. Current spike: 47 occurrences in last 6h correlated with large prompts (>12k chars).
- per-request cost delta when using priority routing: expect <=+3% cost overhead; current observed +1.8%.

Action items (owner, ETA):
- Maya: Push hotfix for tokenizer edge-case; coordinate with SRE for canary patch rollout. ETA: 2026-03-24 EOD.
- Jordan: Add a dashboard card that breaks fallback rate by model_variant and prompt_length; add alert when fallback_rate >1% sustained 30m. ETA: 2026-03-24 12:00.
- Sofia: Update modal microcopy and add tooltip examples for "fallback scope" (request vs route). Prepare 2A/B copy variants for UX test. ETA: 2026-03-25.
- Liam: Scale up kv-cache warmers in us-west1 for tomorrow's load test; confirm autoscaling headroom. ETA: 2026-03-24 09:00.
- Anika: Compile quick customer-facing note for CS if rollback is necessary; draft in #cs-ops. ETA: 2026-03-24 11:00.

Open questions / backlog candidates:
- Should fallback decisions be logged as structured JSON with model metadata (quantization profile, kernel selection) for easier post-mortem? Pros: faster triage. Cons: increased event size and storage. (Assign to Jordan + infra spike).
- Can we provide a UX affordance to "preview" the fallback output at rollout time? Feels useful for debug but could leak model details. (Sofia to prototype flow).

Canary notes & experiment design:
- Experiment: compare two fallback selection policies: "model-variant-first" vs "region-cost-priority". Goal: minimize latency regressions while keeping cost delta <5%.
- Slice criteria: long prompts (>4k tokens), tokenized length >32k bytes, and routes with >10k monthly calls.
- Success metrics: 95th percentile latency <= baseline + 30ms, fallback_rate <=1.5%.

Handoff for weekend on-call:
- Primary on-call: Maya (Fri-Sun). Secondary support: Liam.
- If tokenization_failure spikes >100 events/hour or any P1 errors, page on-call channel and escalate to eng-sre.
- For rollout rollback: command documented in rollout-playbook (linked_artifacts). Quick rollback steps: pause canary -> redirect 100% traffic to stable variant -> run health checks -> communicate to CS.

Notes to self / rough TODOs (informal):
- Add small unit test for tokenizer that simulates mixed UTF8 punctuation and very long prompt boundaries. Keep tests lightweight.
- Move the fallback event schema into a central analytics repo (avoid duplication).
- Follow up with product about whether admins should be able to set per-route fallback policy (config surface).

References / links:
- Rollout playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/rollout-playbook
- Tokenizer ticket: ENG-1883
- Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4821

If you see anything missing or want a quick sync, ping me in #console-tooling or @Maya on Slack.

-- Maya
